channel.title: BillsZilla Blog
channel.description: Practical invoicing guides for freelancers and small businesses: how to write invoices, quotes vs invoices, getting paid faster, and invoicing and tax news.

item.title: Spain Sets Its E-Invoicing Dates — What It Means for Freelancers Everywhere
item.description: Spain's e-invoicing mandate finally has fixed dates: 6 October 2027 for larger businesses, 2028 for the rest. What changed, and the checklist for freelancers.

item.title: How to Make a Receipt: The 7 Things Every Receipt Needs
item.description: A receipt is proof a payment happened. Learn the 7 things every receipt needs — receipt numbers, payment dates, tax, method and more.

item.title: E-Invoicing's Next Wave: UK Sets a 2029 Date — What It Means for Freelancers Everywhere
item.description: HMRC's e-invoicing roadmap (28 Oct 2026): VAT e-invoices become mandatory from 1 April 2029. What changed, who is in scope, and what freelancers should do now.

item.title: UAE E-Invoicing Deadline: Appoint a Provider by 30 October or Face AED 5,000 Monthly Fines
item.description: The UAE tax authority warns businesses to meet e-invoicing deadlines: 30 October 2026 for large firms, 31 March 2027 for smaller ones, or face monthly fines.

item.title: E-Invoicing Is Going Mandatory: The 2026–2028 Deadlines You Need to Know
item.description: Spain just set its e-invoicing dates, France is already live, and Germany, the UAE and Ireland follow. What the global mandate wave means for freelancers.

item.title: How to Save and Send an Invoice as a PDF
item.description: Why PDF is the best format for sending invoices, how to save your invoice as a PDF, name the file properly, and send it by email or WhatsApp.

item.title: Invoice Payment Terms Explained: Net 30, Net 15, Due on Receipt
item.description: What Net 30, Net 15 and Due on Receipt mean, which terms suit your business, and the exact wording to put on invoices so you get paid on time.

item.title: Invoice vs Quote vs Receipt vs Proforma
item.description: Invoice, quote, receipt, proforma invoice — four documents, four different jobs. Learn which one to send and when, with real freelancer examples.

item.title: How to Write an Invoice: The 9 Things Every Invoice Needs
item.description: The complete invoice checklist: invoice numbers, dates, line items, taxes, payment terms and more. Write invoices that get you paid faster.
